# sigma_members (Data Source)

Lists Sigma members with documented list filters. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_members" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Exact email filter (`email`).
- `include_archived` (Boolean) Whether archived members are included (`includeArchived`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `include_inactive` (Boolean) Whether inactive SCIM members are included (`includeInactive`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `search` (String) Search filter (`search`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `members` (Attributes List) Members in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `home_folder_id` (String) ID of the member's My Documents folder.
- `id` (String) Member ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether deactivated.
- `is_inactive` (Boolean) Whether inactive through SCIM.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `member_type` (String) Account type.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `user_kind` (String) User kind.
